name: institutional_flow_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, large directional institutional orders — FII block buys/sells, index ETF rebalancing, or algo momentum-ignition sequences — produce visible 5-second volume spikes of 4-8x the 10-minute rolling baseline. When such a spike bar is also strongly directional (bar return > 0.03%, roughly 6+ index points in 5 seconds) and closes on the correct side of the session VWAP, it signals net institutional conviction in that direction. Other quantitative participants detect the large print within 1-3 bars and layer in behind it, creating a 15-45 second follow-through window before price fully absorbs the order. Because NIFTY and BANKNIFTY are highly liquid and smooth compared to individual stocks, false volume spikes from thin-book bounces are rare, making the volume signal cleaner than on single equities.
core_signal_oneliner: 4x volume spike bar with directional price impact above/below VWAP for institutional order follow-through
